notes: The verbless clause's copula joins the prepositional predicate עַל and heads on it (rule 49); the presentative תִּהְיֶה keeps its dummy there (rule 21) while the explicit subject אֵשׁ takes only its own word.
יוֹמָם and לַיְלָה each take their supplied 'by' under rule 33; בּוֹ fused as therein.
